correctness.rationale: For iid uniform circle points the cyclic spacings have Dirichlet(1,...,1) law. Exact moments of U_k=sum D_i^k imply sigma_{33}=360, sigma_{35}=28800, sigma_{55}=3254400, and the positive Schur complement 950400. Taylor expansions S=pi-(pi^3/6)U3+(pi^5/120)U5+O_L2(n^-6), A=pi-4(pi^3/6)U3+16(pi^5/120)U5+O_L2(n^-6) justify the exact quadratic variance minimizer. Independently checked rational arithmetic establishes n^2(lambda*-1/3)->16 pi^2/3; optimized n^9 variance ->1056 pi^10 versus known fixed 3616 pi^10; determinant identity for Cov(S,A) yields n^4(1-Corr)->297 pi^4/10. Variance(B)>0 because B=A-S is nonconstant on the open gap simplex for each n>=3; no MSE or unbiasedness claim.
